skuLines.examples: Babyhug 5-pc jhabla set, Mee Mee cotton jhabla, Tinycare newborn set, Morisons Baby Dreams
skuLines.seasonality: Year-round; every birth on campus triggers one

skuLines.line: Nappy cover / plastic-outer pant + waterproof bed protector
skuLines.examples: Mee Mee nappy pants, Luvlap dry sheet, Bey Bee waterproof sheet

skuLines.notes: Pairs with the langot line; sell as an attach, never alone.

skuLines.examples: Bodycare Kids baby vest, Dollar Baby vest, Rupa Bumchums infant vest
skuLines.notes: MRP-printed hosiery, so margin is fixed by the brand; stock for turnover, not markup.

skuLines.line: Baby bodysuit / romper, half and full sleeve
skuLines.examples: Mini Klub cotton bodysuit pack of 3, Babyhug romper, Dollar Baby bodysuit, Kaboos printed romper
skuLines.notes: Front-open / envelope-neck styles only for under-6m — mothers reject over-the-head on a small baby.

skuLines.examples: Babyhug sleepsuit, Mee Mee footed romper, Babyshop (Landmark) sleepsuit

skuLines.notes: Full-foot coverage matters here — hill floors are cold and most staff quarters are unheated.

skuLines.line: Baby woollen suit set (sweater + cap + booties)
skuLines.examples: Montaly baby woollen set, Little Panda pullover, Litton baby sweater, local Ludhiana knits
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb; gifting spike at Lohri and Gurpurab
skuLines.notes: Needs moth-proof, dry storage through the monsoon. Buy shallow across many sizes, not deep in one.

skuLines.examples: Infispace baby beanie set, Mee Mee cap-mitten-bootie set, Footleap winter cap
skuLines.seasonality: Oct-Feb heavy; a cotton version sells year-round for newborns
skuLines.notes: Lowest-ticket, highest-repeat infant line — always at the counter, never in the back.

skuLines.line: Swaddle / wrapping sheet — muslin and flannel
skuLines.examples: Mee Mee baby wrap, Bey Bee muslin swaddle, Oscar Home swaddle pack of 2, Yutiriti flannel wrap
skuLines.notes: Doubles as a feed cover and pram sheet; families buy 3-4 per baby.

skuLines.line: Hooded baby blanket / wrapper (cotton and fleece)
skuLines.examples: Kalra Magic hooded blanket, AJ Home flannel wrapper, Catcub towel-cum-blanket

skuLines.examples: Catcub hooded towel, Mee Mee baby towel, Bombay Dyeing baby range
skuLines.notes: Also a standard newborn-gift item; keep 2-3 gift-worthy prints.

skuLines.examples: Mee Mee bib pack, Luvlap plastic-back bib, Babyhug printed bibs

skuLines.examples: Kalka Hosiery baby socks pack of 5, HF Lumen pack of 12, Bonjour baby socks
skuLines.notes: Highest-repeat infant SKU — they are lost constantly. Multipacks only; singles are not worth the shelf.

skuLines.examples: Famaya cotton leggings pack of 5, Kids Cave baby leggings, Bodycare Kids pyjama

skuLines.examples: Babeezworld dungaree set, Aatumn Kids Wear pack of 3, Mini Klub set
skuLines.notes: Sets sell where separates do not — a mother guessing a size wants one decision.

skuLines.examples: Sarika Dresses cotton frock, Babyhug frock, Mini Klub dress
skuLines.notes: Keep sleeves and length conservative — this is a Sikh institutional campus, sleeveless/short does not move.

skuLines.line: Toddler tee + shorts / tee + pant set
skuLines.examples: Musnah Garments pack of 2, Kids Cave set, Dollar Baby set
skuLines.notes: The cheap-end workhorse: toddlers on campus wear these out and stain them; sell in twos.

skuLines.examples: Trampoline puffer romper, Babyhug snowsuit, HF Lumen hooded winter suit
skuLines.notes: Hill-specific and genuinely needed for a baby carried outdoors, but sizes 6-24m only and shallow depth — it is a one-per-baby purchase.

skuLines.examples: Babyhug gift set, Mee Mee newborn hamper, Baby Moo gift box
skuLines.notes: Pure convenience margin: colleagues visiting a new baby have nowhere else to buy a gift within 30-50 km. Keep it wrapped and ready.

skuLines.examples: Rupa Frontline pack of 3, Dixcy Scott Clasz pack of 5/6, Bodycare Kids, Lux Cozi kids

skuLines.examples: Bodycare teen slip, Lux beginners bra, local hosiery beginner range

skuLines.line: School uniform shirt (white / sky, half and full sleeve)
skuLines.examples: Kids Club cotton shirt, Bodycare uniform range, local Ludhiana uniform stitchers

skuLines.examples: Kids Club trousers, local uniform makers, Bodycare uniform bottoms
skuLines.notes: Stock a length-alteration allowance — children grow mid-term and hemming on site is the difference between a sale and a trip to Nahan.

skuLines.notes: Modest cut is the institutional requirement; the dupatta is part of the set and is lost most often — stock it as a standalone too.

skuLines.line: School sweater / cardigan in uniform colour
skuLines.examples: Neva school sweater, Goodluck cardigan, Monte Carlo kids, local Ludhiana knitwear
skuLines.notes: Biggest single winter line for a 5,000-person residential school. Colour-matched to the uniform, so it cannot be substituted — under-buying it is the costliest stock-out in the category.

skuLines.line: School blazer / winter uniform coat (senior classes)
skuLines.examples: Cantabil kids blazer, Duke kids, local tailoring to school spec

skuLines.examples: RC Royal Class pack of 5, Bonjour school socks, Neska Moda, Balenzia kids

skuLines.examples: Mini Klub tee, Duke kids polo, Dollar Champion, Tiruppur unbranded

trends2026: Multipack-as-the-buying-unit: pack-of-3/5/6/12 has become the default retail unit in kids hosiery, socks, vests, leggings and baby basics — single pieces increasingly do not justify shelf space
Character licensing gone mainstream: Disney/Marvel/Peppa-type licensed prints now run down to the value tier, not just premium brands
Front-open / envelope-neck infant construction winning: button-through thermal suits, sleepsuits and bodysuits displacing pullover styles for 0-18m
Cotton-first and 'chemical-free' claims (organic, GOTS, dye-free) as the top infant-wear purchase driver — cotton is ~58% of baby apparel material share and rising

Big-format retail entering baby/kids fashion hard: Landmark Group launched Babyshop in India (Jan 2025), Popees Baby Care planning ~42 new stores in FY26 — expectations of range and price are being set by these formats even in small towns
Athleisure and co-ord sets replacing formal kidswear for non-uniform occasions; track pants, hoodies and matched two-pieces now the everyday non-uniform default
Gender-neutral / unisex infant basics — same SKU sold across boys and girls, which cuts a small store's SKU count and size-risk substantially
Thermals and fleece treated as a year-planned core category rather than a winter afterthought, with Ludhiana/Tiruppur supply needing Sept indents
Value-tier unbranded Tiruppur and Ludhiana supply reaching sharp price points (₹150-350 sets) through marketplaces, resetting what a customer thinks a kids' set should cost
adjacentServices: On-site tailoring counter — hemming, waist alteration, sleeve shortening for uniforms and hand-me-downs; the single highest-value attach in a captive market where children grow mid-term
Name-tape printing and embroidery labelling for hostel clothing (mandatory in practice, currently a parent's problem)
Pre-packed class-wise uniform kits (shirt + trouser/salwar + sweater + socks + tie + belt in one size-tagged bag), supplied on institutional indent to Akal Academy
Newborn welcome hamper / gift-wrap service for staff families — the only gift source within 30-50 km
Generous size-exchange window: sizes are always guessed in a store with no fitting culture; a no-friction swap converts the hesitant buyer and is nearly free in a captive market
Indent / pre-order book for sizes and colours not stocked, cleared on a weekly run to Rajgarh / Nahan / Solan — captures the demand that currently leaks off-campus
Woollen dry-clean and moth-proof off-season storage pickup (Mar-Apr), plus a paid storage option for hostel children going home
Seasonal swap or buy-back sale for outgrown winterwear — jackets and sweaters are worn one season and are the costliest thing a staff family replaces
Costume rental for annual functions and Gurpurab skits instead of stocking costumes
Staff-account / salary-deduction credit for the two spike weeks (Mar-Apr uniform, Oct-Nov winter), when a family's apparel bill lands all at once

Method note (honesty): WebSearch quota for this session was already exhausted on the first call, so all research ran through direct page fetches. BigBasket (needs lat-long), Blinkit (403), Zepto, JioMart (JS-rendered) and Amazon.in (bot-blocked) refused automated reads, so their category pages could NOT be inspected — q-commerce/modern-trade assortment claims here are inferred from the market reports and Snapdeal listings, not read off those retailers' own pages. Price bands are online marketplace prices; a captive hill store would typically sit at or near MRP, above these. Margin bands are industry-typical ranges from experience, not read from a cited source — treat them as indicative (±10 pts), and the two GST-slab notes as 'verify current threshold', not as stated fact.
